# Software libraries

The outside libraries this layer's code imports: one `software-library/1.0.0` node per dependency in `package.json`, with the version and sha512 that `bun.lock` pins, the registry tarball, the SPDX licence read from the installed package, the range, whether it is a dev dependency, the files that import it (`usedBy`) and the `types/*.d.ts` shim that types it (bpmn-moddle, dmn-moddle). GENERATED, never hand-edited: `bun run cat libraries:derive` writes it and `libraries:check` fails on a stale node, an import no node names, and a shim no node names. The kind is cat-harness's; this layer keeps its own nodes because it pins its own versions. `held/<layer>/` holds the nodes of each layer below the kind, which may not name it (bootstrap-tools): `software-library/1.2.0` with `layer` naming the layer it describes, derived at this layer's pins.

Part of [C@T Harness Tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-tools-libraries`, holding `software-library`.
